notes.title: Natural Spirit is available
notes.content:
|🚨📢 𝗡𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗔𝗟 𝗦𝗣𝗜𝗥𝗜𝗧 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘀𝗲 🐕🌳|
⭐️𝗔𝗩𝗔𝗜𝗟𝗔𝗕𝗟𝗘 𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗧𝗘𝗔𝗠 𝗡𝗢𝗪!⭐️

As promised, we are very proud to share with you our new game 𝗡𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗔𝗟 𝗦𝗣𝗜𝗥𝗜𝗧!
Available on Steam’s platform for PC and MAC, it is a third-person adventure game developed by OriGaming Studio.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗽𝗶𝗿𝗶𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗻𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂!
You will play as the shiba 𝗬𝘂𝗸𝗶𝘁𝗼, to help the spirit 𝗔𝘂𝗿𝗮 to save the 𝗧𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗲 from a certain death that would doom us all...

Do not hesitate to help our little friend by clicking to this link and play to our game.

Feel free to talk about it around you in order to help us!
😊 𝗕𝗜𝗚 𝗧𝗛𝗔𝗡𝗞𝗦 𝗧𝗢 𝗬𝗢𝗨!
